title: Halgurd Mountain Hike from Choman
full_text:
Head to Choman for a hike up Halgurd Mountain.
The hike will be for 6-8 hours total, depending on fitness level.
You may choose to do one of multiple easier hikes in the area.
Head back to Erbil.
Depending on arrival time, we may have a city tour of Erbil.
